products.title: Handknotted Sungudi - RETTAPETTU ( DARK BLUE)
products.body:
Handknotted Sungudi with Rettapettu borders

COLORS: DARK BLUE + RAMA GREEN

Crafted in soft cotton, countless tiny portions of the fabric are individually tied by hand and resist-dyed to reveal Sungudi’s characteristic ring-like dots. The richly detailed border and pallu lend the saree its distinctive old-world beauty.

Lightweight, breathable and beautifully nostalgic, this is a timeless Madurai drape that carries the patience of the artisan and the legacy of a nearly forgotten craft.

collections.title: BALUCHARI FROM BENGAL
collections.description: Rooted in the rich weaving traditions of Bengal, our Baluchari sarees are a celebration of storytelling through silk. Handwoven by skilled artisans, these sarees are known for their intricate pallus and borders that depict scenes inspired by mythology, culture, and heritage. At Krsaangi, we bring you thoughtfully curated Balucharis that blend timeless artistry with elegance — heirloom weaves meant to be treasured for generations. Perfect for those who appreciate craftsmanship, detail, and the quiet beauty of Indian handlooms.

collections.title: Bhujodi from Kutch
collections.description: Explore authentic Bhujodi handwoven sarees, handcrafted by master weavers of Kutch, Gujarat. Featuring traditional motifs, fine craftsmanship, and premium natural fabrics, each saree reflects the rich heritage of Indian handloom weaving while offering timeless elegance for every occasion.

collections.title: IKAT SILKS
collections.description: This collection of Ikat Silks highlights the tie-and-dye process, where patterns are created through careful dyeing of the yarn before it is woven.Defined by their characteristic blurred edges and rhythmic patterns, these sarees carry a distinct visual identity.

collections.title: Jamdani
collections.description: Jamdani is an intricate handweaving technique where motifs are woven individually into the fabric using supplementary weft threads. Each motif is patiently built by hand, creating patterns that seem to float effortlessly on the surface of the saree. Slow, precise and deeply artisanal, Jamdani celebrates the beauty of the weaver’s hand—where every motif is created one thread at a time.

collections.title: Kodalikarrupur
collections.description: Kodalikaruppur sarees are a rare textile tradition from Tamil Nadu, known specifically for their intricate block-printed artistry. Using hand-carved wooden blocks, detailed motifs inspired by temple architecture and classical themes are printed with precision onto fine fabric. Subtle, artistic, and deeply rooted in heritage, these sarees stand out for their craftsmanship and timeless appeal.

collections.title: Kotpad - Tribal Weave from Odisha
collections.description: Kotpad sarees are handwoven tribal textiles from Odisha, known for their earthy tones and natural dyeing process using organic elements like tree bark. Crafted on traditional looms by tribal weavers, these sarees feature simple yet powerful motifs inspired by nature and daily life. Lightweight, breathable, and deeply rooted in heritage, Kotpad sarees stand out for their raw beauty and sustainable craftsmanship

collections.title: MAATHEY: MOTHER'S KANJIVARAM
collections.description: Maathey is a collection of vintage Kanjivarams that feel like they’ve come straight from a mother’s wardrobe—solid, familiar, and deeply rooted.Each saree carries a quiet sense of nostalgia, with colours and textures that have stood the test of time

collections.title: Madurai Sungudi - Handknotted
collections.description:
Woven in Madurai, this Sungudi saree celebrates a centuries-old tradition of hand-knotting and resist dyeing. Each tiny dot is individually tied by hand before the fabric is dyed, creating the characteristic dotted patterns unique to Sungudi.
Lightweight, breathable and beautifully comfortable, the saree carries subtle variations that reflect its handmade character. A timeless drape rooted in the textile heritage of Madurai—perfect for everyday elegance and intimate celebrations.

collections.title: Moirang Phee
collections.description: Moirang Phee from Manipur is a traditional handwoven textile known for its distinctive geometric patterns and bold, structured motifs. Woven using fine cotton or silk blends, these sarees carry a strong cultural identity, often inspired by local folklore and symbols. Lightweight, breathable, and rooted in heritage, Moirang Phee is where simplicity meets striking design

collections.description: The Patola Ikats collection brings together sarees woven using the single and double ikat technique, where design is created through careful dyeing of both warp and weft yarns.Structured, detailed, and distinctive, these sarees carry a strong visual identity.

collections.description: The Pazhamai collection focuses on recreating vintage Kanjivarams through careful research and collaboration with skilled weavers.It brings back colours, structures, and details that once defined the weave but are now slowly disappearing.

collections.title: POCHAMPALLY IKATS
collections.description: The Pochampally Ikats collection brings together sarees woven using the tie-and-dye process, where design begins at the yarn stage itself.With characteristic patterns and rhythmic compositions, these sarees carry a strong and recognizable identity.

collections.title: Ponduru Khadi Jamdani
collections.description: Handwoven in the fine, airy texture of Ponduru Khadi, these sarees bring together the quiet beauty of handspun cotton with the artistry of Jamdani weaving. Delicate motifs are intricately woven into the fabric using supplementary weft, creating a saree that is lightweight, breathable and beautifully rooted in India’s handloom traditions.

collections.title: Pracheen Ajrakhs
collections.description: Pracheen Ajrakhs are known for their perfect signature blockprintes Ajrakh done entirely on organic colors / natural pigments

collections.title: PROJECT KATTAM COLLECTIVE: CHECKS & PLAIDS
collections.description: Project Kattam Collective focuses on Kanjivarams defined by plaids and checks—one of the most fundamental design elements of the weave.Rooted in structure and tradition, these sarees highlight the precision and rhythm of kattam in its many forms.

collections.title: READYMADE BLOUSES
collections.description: Handcrafted ready to wear blouses tailored to perfection.

collections.title: Silk Cottons
collections.description: Silk cotton sarees that bring together the richness of silk and the ease of cotton—lightweight, breathable, and effortlessly elegant. Designed for everyday comfort without losing the charm of traditional weaves, these are sarees you can truly live in

collections.title: SNIGDHA: NO ZARI KANJIVARAMS
collections.description: The Snigdha collection explores Kanjivarams without zari, bringing attention to the texture and finish of pure silk.Minimal, refined, and comfortable, these sarees offer a quieter take on tradition

collections.title: SWARA: ESSENTIAL KANJIVARAMS
collections.description: Swara is a collection of essential Kanjivarams defined by self and semi-contrast borders, without korvai.Minimal in structure and refined in appearance, these sarees focus on simplicity, making them versatile and easy to wear.

collections.title: Terracotta Jewelry - Artisan made
collections.description: Explore our collection of handmade Terracotta clay jewelery crafted by Women artisans

collections.title: VARNIKA : SILVER TONED HANDCRAFTED JEWELRY
collections.description:
Please note: These pieces feature a silver-tone finish and are not made of pure or sterling silver.
Rooted in tradition and shaped by the beauty of Indian craftsmanship, Krsaangi VARNIKA brings together handcrafted jewellery with an old-world soul. Each piece is thoughtfully created with intricate details and finished in an antique silver tone, echoing the character of treasured heirloom ornaments.
Designed to complement handwoven sarees and timeless Indian silhouettes, these jewels celebrate heritage without being bound by occasion—distinctive, versatile and effortlessly beautiful.

collections.title: VRIKSHA: HANDCRAFTED FUSION SAREES
collections.description: Vriksha is a collection of handcrafted fusion sarees that bring together handwoven silks with artisanal techniques such as kalamkari, bandhani, madhubani, and kasuti.Each saree reflects a meeting of traditions, where weaving and surface craft come together in a thoughtful and balanced way.
